blocked = (input or {}).get('blocked_commands') or []
needed = ['users.find', 'access.review_pack', 'custody.detect_ungoverned']
missing = [c for c in needed if c in blocked]
output = {'ok': not missing, 'missing_scopes_block': missing, 'granted': (input or {}).get('scopes_granted'), 'reason': 'A review that silently skips a section is worse than one that refuses to start.' if missing else 'All sections available.'}

rows = (input or {}).get('rows') or []
dormant = [r for r in rows if r.get('dormant') or r.get('never_signed_in')]
admin_unknown = [r for r in rows if r.get('admin_roles_available') is False]
standing_admin = [r for r in rows if r.get('holds_standing_admin')]
output = {'reviewed': len(rows), 'complete': (input or {}).get('complete'), 'dormant': [{'id': r['user']['id'], 'login': r['user']['login'], 'days': r.get('days_since_login'), 'apps': r.get('application_count')} for r in dormant], 'dormant_count': len(dormant), 'standing_admin_count': len(standing_admin), 'admin_visibility_gap': len(admin_unknown)}

items = input or []
output = {'proposed': [i['id'] for i in items], 'count': len(items), 'note': 'Proposed only. Nothing here is removed by this workflow; the removals below run only for user ids a human puts in the run context.'}

counts = ((input or {}).get('counts') or {})
output = {'landed': counts.get('landed', 0), 'failed': counts.get('failed', 0), 'unresolved': counts.get('unresolved', 0), 'all_landed': (input or {}).get('all_landed'), 'note': 'An unresolved write raises before reaching here, so seeing this node at all means no outcome was left unknown.'}
